title: The TUI help line advertises a key that does something else

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
`tui.HELP` reads `n new`, but `n` is wired to `ops.promote`. There is no way to create an
item from the TUI at all, so the string promises a feature that does not exist and
mislabels one that does.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: None worth writing for a string; the fix is one word.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Change `n new` to `n promote`. Then decide separately whether the TUI should be able to
add an item — if it should, that is a different slice and this one just stops lying in
the meantime.

**Not in this slice:** adding items from the TUI.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Read the help line against the key table in `act`.
